How we pick them.

fact_check

Checked first

We look at every listing before it goes up, and we only list opportunities meant for teenagers.

tune

Matched to you

You'll see the ones that fit your age, interests and the skills you're building first.

event_available

Clear details

Who can apply, what you need and the deadline, all in one place.

Have an opportunity for teens?

Companies, NGOs, schools and event organisers can list competitions, scholarships, internships and events.
